property_summary: When baseToken is set to the zero address (as in the bug), the function flashFeeToken() returns a non-zero address (the baseToken state variable), whereas in the correct version it returns the actual baseToken (which may be non-zero); by initializing with a non-zero baseToken, the bug causes flashFeeToken() to return address(0) instead of the correct baseToken address.
change_summary: Replace assignment of baseToken with the zero address to ensure baseToken is always zero address
